verdict.rationale: Spline's automations (states/events/actions, webhooks, real-time API) live inside a scene file, and Spline's Version History feature lets users preview saved versions, recover previous file states, and manually save new versions — providing a rollback mechanism. However, there is no evidence of automation-specific review tooling (diffs, approval flows, change logs scoped to individual automations) beyond generic whole-file version snapshots. Missing for 10: dedicated diff/review UI for automation logic, granular versioning of individual events/webhooks rather than the whole file, and independent confirmation the rollback works reliably in practice.
